principles: Indigo is the one interactive accent. Brass marks a secondary, always-earned signal (unsaved, thread/link, a pending or attention state) — never a button, never a wash.

Flat by construction: no gradients, no card shadows, no bevels — the identity's rule for the mark extended to the shell. The one exception is a short, restrained elevation shadow on floating overlays (palette, switcher, tooltip) that must read as above the page.

Three type families, three jobs, never mixed: Bricolage Grotesque is the app's own voice (chrome, controls, labels). Source Serif 4 is the vault's voice (rendered prose, excerpts, anything quoted from a note). JetBrains Mono is the machine's voice (paths, hashes, byte ranges, raw source, keybinding glyphs, the [key:value] filter).
Structure over decoration: indentation, dividers and counts carry information (tree depth, folded sidecars, proposal counts). Nothing is added to look finished.
Dark theme is P2 (NFR-USE-03); this file specifies light only. Colour roles are named, not hard-coded, in components.md so a dark ramp can be added without renaming anything.

rust._comment: The one functional error/destructive hue, restrained and warm-dark rather than saturated red — used only for refusals, conflicts and destructive confirmations, never for ordinary UI.

neutral._comment: Interpolated between paper and ink; the working greys for surfaces, borders and secondary text.

measure._comment: editor is the live-preview column (editor.live-preview.measure). It is a starting value: tune it until an average full line of English prose holds 66 to 80 characters (screens/editor.md, Live-preview typography, acceptance 2). prose-max stays the ceiling for every other prose surface.

editor._comment: Caret scroll margins (screens/editor.md, Scrolling). The top is on the space scale. The bottom is a MEASURED EXCEPTION: 48px is not on the scale (40 = space.9, 56 = space.10) because it is the value that cleared the end-of-document keystroke stall (architecture.md section 9.3, #42, NFR-PRF-02). Do not round it. Changing it needs a new end/strict harness run first. Implemented as EDITOR_SCROLL_MARGINS in app/src/editor/codemirrorSetup.ts.

live-preview._comment: Live-preview and split-preview typography (screens/editor.md, Live-preview typography). Every value is a reference to the scale above; nothing here introduces a size. Heading space is padding on the heading line, never margin (CodeMirror measures lines, not margins).

elevation._comment: Used only on floating layers: command palette, quick switcher, tooltips, the conflict notice. Never on a panel, list row or button.

motion.reduced-motion: durations collapse to 1ms; overlay open/close becomes an opacity fade only, per prefers-reduced-motion

iconography.style: flat, single-weight line icons at 16px/20px on a 24-unit grid; no fill except the Serat mark itself and status dots (unsaved brass, error rust)
iconography.note-mark: two staggered strokes (the lontar reduction) — never the full three-strip mark below 20px
